name: Warm Winter
source:
The Final Exam for the High-schooler Senior graders are near, Orion whom is one of their physic teacher did a great job in making most of the students achieve good performance because of his accurate teaching.

However, there's one student that keeps failing only at his subject. His name is Cleon, his grades are ordinary, or even below standard. At this last year, He did improved at several subjects, but not on Orion's subject. So Orion planned some daily private tutor for him.

[From [url=http://ahoguu.deviantart.com/journal/OrionxCleon-VN-Warm-Winter-427100836]DeviantArt[/url]]

Features characters from the [url=http://hmls.deviantart.com/]HMLS[/url] RP group.
translation:
高中生年级的期末考试临近。物理教师奥利恩凭借精准的教学，帮助大多数学生取得了优异成绩。

然而，有一名学生只有他的科目总是不及格。他叫克莱昂，成绩普通，甚至低于标准。到了最后一年，他在几门科目上有所进步，却没有改善物理成绩。因此，奥利恩计划每天给他补课。

[摘自[url=http://ahoguu.deviantart.com/journal/OrionxCleon-VN-Warm-Winter-427100836]DeviantArt[/url]]

包含[url=http://hmls.deviantart.com/]HMLS[/url]角色扮演群组中的角色。
